explanation.tr:
Sık kullanılan yazım kuralları:
• 'i before e, except after c': believe, friend, piece ama receive, ceiling
• Sessiz -e düşer (+ ünlüyle başlayan ek): make → making, hope → hoped; ama -ful/-ly gibi ünsüzle başlayan eklerde kalır: hopeful, lovely
• Kısa ünlü + tek ünsüz → ünsüz ikilenir: stop → stopped, big → bigger, run → running
• Ünsüz + y → i: happy → happiness, carry → carried (ama -ing'de y kalır: carrying)
• Çoğul: -s, -es (bus → buses), f → ves (wolf → wolves)
• Sık karıştırılanlar: their/there/they're, your/you're, its/it's, to/too/two
explanation.tk:
Köp ulanylýan ýazylyş düzgünleri:
• 'i before e, except after c': believe, friend, piece, emma receive, ceiling
• Okalmaýan -e düşýär (+ çekimli bilen başlanýan goşulma): make → making, hope → hoped; emma çekimsiz bilen başlanýan -ful/-ly ýaly goşulmalarda galýar: hopeful, lovely
• Gysga çekimli + bir çekimsiz → çekimsiz iki esse: stop → stopped, big → bigger, run → running
• Çekimsiz + y → i: happy → happiness, carry → carried (emma -ing-de y galýar: carrying)
• Köplük: -s, -es (bus → buses), f → ves (wolf → wolves)
• Köp garyşdyrylýanlar: their/there/they're, your/you're, its/it's, to/too/two
explanation.ru:
Частые правила орфографии:
• 'i before e, except after c': believe, friend, piece, но receive, ceiling
• Немое -e выпадает перед суффиксом на гласную: make → making, hope → hoped; перед суффиксом на согласную остаётся: hopeful, lovely
• Краткая гласная + одна согласная → удвоение: stop → stopped, big → bigger, run → running
• Согласная + y → i: happy → happiness, carry → carried (но в -ing y сохраняется: carrying)
• Мн. ч.: -s, -es (bus → buses), f → ves (wolf → wolves)
• Частые путаницы: their/there/they're, your/you're, its/it's, to/too/two

topic: Spelling: Words ending in -y – Spelling Exercise 1
title: Words Ending in -y: Plurals

explanation.tr:
-y ile biten isimlerin çoğulu:
• Ünsüz + y → y düşer, -ies eklenir: baby → babies, city → cities, lady → ladies, party → parties, story → stories
• Ünlü (a, e, o, u) + y → sadece -s eklenir: boy → boys, day → days, key → keys, toy → toys, monkey → monkeys
İpucu: y'den önceki harfe bak!
explanation.tk:
-y bilen gutarýan atlaryň köplügi:
• Çekimsiz + y → y düşýär, -ies goşulýar: baby → babies, city → cities, lady → ladies, party → parties, story → stories
• Çekimli (a, e, o, u) + y → diňe -s goşulýar: boy → boys, day → days, key → keys, toy → toys, monkey → monkeys
Maslahat: y-den öňki harpa seret!
explanation.ru:
Мн. ч. существительных на -y:
• Согласная + y → y меняется на -ies: baby → babies, city → cities, lady → ladies, party → parties, story → stories
• Гласная (a, e, o, u) + y → просто -s: boy → boys, day → days, key → keys, toy → toys, monkey → monkeys
Подсказка: смотри на букву перед y!

topic: Spelling: Words ending in -y – Spelling Exercise 3
title: Words Ending in -y: Adjectives and Adverbs

explanation.tr:
-y ile biten sıfatlarda yazım:
• Karşılaştırma: ünsüz + y → -ier / -iest: happy → happier → the happiest, easy → easier → the easiest, funny → funnier
• Ünlü + y → değişmez: grey → greyer

  İstisnalar: shy → shyly, dry → dryly (tek heceli)

explanation.tk:
-y bilen gutarýan sypatlarda ýazylyş:
• Deňeşdirme: çekimsiz + y → -ier / -iest: happy → happier → the happiest, easy → easier → the easiest, funny → funnier
• Çekimli + y → üýtgemeýär: grey → greyer
• Hal (-ly): happy → happily, easy → easily, lucky → luckily, angry → angrily
  Kadadan çykmalar: shy → shyly, dry → dryly (bir bogunly)

explanation.ru:
Написание прилагательных на -y:
• Сравнение: согласная + y → -ier / -iest: happy → happier → the happiest, easy → easier → the easiest, funny → funnier
• Гласная + y → без изменений: grey → greyer
• Наречие (-ly): happy → happily, easy → easily, lucky → luckily, angry → angrily
  Исключения: shy → shyly, dry → dryly (односложные)
• Существительное (-ness): happy → happiness, lazy → laziness, kind → kindness

topic: Spelling: Words ending in -y – Spelling Exercise 4
title: Words Ending in -y: Mixed Spelling Test

explanation.tr:
Tüm -y kuralları bir arada:
• Ünsüz + y: -ies (çoğul / 3. tekil), -ied (geçmiş), -ier/-iest (karşılaştırma), -ily (zarf), -iness (isim), -iful (beautiful), -iment (merriment)
• Ünlü + y: değişmez: -s, -ed, -er (plays, played, greyer)
• -ing: y her zaman kalır (carrying, enjoying)
• -ish, -ism gibi i ile başlayan eklerde y kalır: babyish
• İstisnalar: said, paid, laid; day → daily, gay → gaily
explanation.tk:
Ähli -y düzgünleri bilelikde:
• Çekimsiz + y: -ies (köplük / 3-nji ýöňkeme), -ied (geçmiş), -ier/-iest (deňeşdirme), -ily (hal), -iness (at), -iful (beautiful), -iment (merriment)
• Çekimli + y: üýtgemeýär: -s, -ed, -er (plays, played, greyer)
• -ing: y hemişe galýar (carrying, enjoying)
• i bilen başlanýan -ish ýaly goşulmalarda y galýar: babyish
• Kadadan çykmalar: said, paid, laid; day → daily, gay → gaily
explanation.ru:
Все правила с -y вместе:
• Согласная + y: -ies (мн. ч. / 3-е лицо), -ied (прошедшее), -ier/-iest (сравнение), -ily (наречие), -iness (существительное), -iful (beautiful), -iment (merriment)
• Гласная + y: без изменений: -s, -ed, -er (plays, played, greyer)
• -ing: y всегда сохраняется (carrying, enjoying)
• Перед суффиксами на i, например -ish, y остаётся: babyish
• Исключения: said, paid, laid; day → daily, gay → gaily
